children: Despite masses of consumers avoiding lettuce in mid-July after the Cyclospora outbreak, Chipotle recovered from that lull by reeling people in during back-to-school season, Davidson analysts say in a note. The burrito chain leaned on new menu items and its rewards programs to help, which the analysts say may help Chipotle post same-store sales north of 3% in the 4Q, a level it hasn't achieved in two years. For 3Q, the analysts expect same-store sales to come in at 2%. Chipotle is scheduled to report earnings on Oct. 28. (natalie.weger@wsj.com)
